chamada: Calls to action, events and local groups by city, over the next {dias} days. Each dot is a whole municipality: the map knows no street, no neighborhood and nobody's location.
desenho: Map of Brazil with {n} cities marked
erro: Could not load the map right now.
vazio: No calls, events or local groups on the map yet.

legenda.chamados: Call: a protest or a community work day.
legenda.eventos: Event: assembly, circle, class and other gatherings.
legenda.nucleos: Local group of a verified organization that chose to appear on the map.
legenda.tamanho: The tile grows with the number, which only shows from 3 up. Local groups never get a number.

estado.nenhuma: No city marked in this state.

cidades.escolher: Tap a city on the map or in the list to see what is there.

toque.explica: There is more than one city at this spot on the map. Choose one.

cidade.orgs: Organizations with a local group here
cidade.atosVazio: No call or event in this city that you can see right now.
cidade.atosMenos: The map's number joins every way of writing this city's name and the next 60 days. The list shows the next ones the Nearby search finds by that name; some may have been written another way.
cidade.atosErro: Could not fetch this city's calls.

fora.titulo: Cities we could not find on the map
fora.texto: These cities were written without the state and the name exists in more than one state, or the name matches no municipality. Writing the city with the state, like "Bom Jesus - PI", puts the dot in place.

fonte: Map of Brazil drawn by Alumia from IBGE's public boundary data. Nothing is loaded from outside.
